reader_moment: A changed supplier date creates pressure to act, but nobody has yet made the customer exposure and recovery gap visible.
reader_promise: A short, customer-first operating check for deciding what needs validation, recovery work, or a joint exception.

lived_tension.answer: A supplier confirmation changes after a customer need-by has been discussed, and the team risks confusing bad news with confirmed customer exposure.
lived_tension.evidence_or_reason: A recurring work moment derived from the project’s customer-first calculator brief; it is not presented as a named customer incident.

practical_handle.answer: The reader can identify the first unanswered gate and take one exact question into a meeting.
practical_handle.evidence_or_reason: The method gives a practical conversation move without requiring a new tool, data claim, or signup.

useful_angle.answer: It separates the quality of a supplier signal, the customer promise, recovery options, and ownership rather than calling all of them ‘a supply risk.’
useful_angle.evidence_or_reason: Each distinction changes the next conversation and protects against a false recovery promise.

information_density.answer: Four gates, one boundary, and one question; every unit changes the next check or decision.
information_density.evidence_or_reason: The density budget is intentionally small so the reader can use the whole guide in under a minute.

density_budget.why_each_unit_earns_space: Each gate removes a different uncertainty: signal quality, customer consequence, recovery feasibility, or accountable exception ownership.

family_choice.field_guide_adds: The visual is a reusable meeting object with an ordered check, a boundary, and a concrete next action; a caption alone would not let the reader trace the method quickly.
family_choice.alternative_family_considered: A relatable short post about the anxiety of escalations.
family_choice.why_not_alternative: Recognition alone would not make the four checks and the exception ownership available for later use.

known_limits: This admission selects an internal Motion Lab and a proposed operating method. It does not prove demand, platform reach, deployment, or operating performance.
